verdict.rationale: The docs reference a user-controllable Model Improvement privacy setting and say chats are used only 'when you allow us'. They also say incognito chats are never used to improve Claude. Together these show an opt-out for training on conversation data, but not for telemetry or usage tracking. Missing for 10: any documented opt-out of product telemetry or analytics and usage tracking (e.g., in the desktop app or Claude Code), detail on what data is collected and how to disable it, and independent corroboration.
